en: Black-and-white aerial view of a historic European city with dense stone buildings, tiled roofs, and a long crenellated wall bordering an open square or courtyard. The scene shows a mix of older medieval structures and more modern institutional buildings in the background. Handwritten-style white text at the bottom reads the city name and mentions that it is a panorama taken from an airplane.
